sn17.8:1.3: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ jarasigā lassa vasamānassāti.
sn17.8:1.5: so kho bhikkhave jarasigālo ukkaṇṇakena nāma rogajātena phuṭṭho neva thalagato ramati na rukkhamūlagato ramati na abbhokāsagato ramati
sn17.8:1.6: yena yena gacchati yattha yattha tiṭṭhati yattha yattha nisīdati yattha yattha nipajjati tattha tattha anayabyasanaṃ āpajjati.
sn17.8:1.7: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacco bhikkhu lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto neva suññā gāragato ramati na rukkhamūlagato ramati na abbhokāsagato ramati
sn17.8:1.8: yena yena gacchati yattha yattha tiṭṭhati yattha yattha nisīdati yattha yattha nipajjati tattha tattha anayabyasanaṃ āpajjati.
